title: Steven Dick's AI protective layer of Earth idea (Galileo Project)

tellings.quote: I think there's a former NASA guy named Steven Dick who's part of Ovillobe's Galileo project who talks about >> uh this is sort of some sort of AI layer like protective layer of Earth.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that Steven Dick, a former NASA figure who is part of the Galileo Project, an effort led by the researcher Avi Loeb to search the skies for unexplained objects, talks about UFOs as some sort of artificial intelligence layer protecting Earth. If true, it would mean something intelligent and non-human is quietly watching over the planet.
